cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you go, could you check this window latch? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

mechanism: A presents closing a shared workspace as settled management while negotiating ever smaller reasons for B to remain.
confusable: Unlike merely being lonely, each completed departure task must create another, and the boss posture must adapt to B refusing delay.
comparison: Workplace closing authority and a shrinking demonstration contrast with the personal host extending a taxi farewell.
seedUse: Use canonical D26-a latch/fan chain and S02-a revision of a confident decision; replace the pasted authority prefix with concessions.
